scenes.say: Twenty-two riders and five rookies. Who is going where in MotoGP twenty twenty-seven?
Pedro Acosta leaves KTM for Ducati and lines up next to Márquez. His deal runs to the end of twenty twenty-eight.
Bagnaia leaves Ducati and signs a four-year deal with Aprilia. His teammate is Bezzecchi.
Jorge Martín moves from Aprilia to the factory Yamaha team. His teammate is Ai Ogura.
Quartararo swaps Yamaha for Honda on a two-year deal, to the end of twenty twenty-eight.
KTM have a brand new pair: Álex Márquez and Fabio Di Giannantonio.
Holgado, Alonso, Guevara, Agius and Bulega, who arrives from WorldSBK, all make their MotoGP debut.
Miller, Binder and Morbidelli head to WorldSBK: Yamaha, BMW and factory Ducati.
The full calendar and line-ups are on LapRadar.

title: MotoGP 2027: who goes where before the 850cc era
